description.value: Mah Milk Bar is a hybrid neighbourhood grocery store and cozy coffee shop on Victoria Drive in East Vancouver, run by owners Maggie and Harry (M and H — Mah). The cafe offers specialty rotating espresso and freshly made breakfast and lunch sandwiches, alongside a curated selection of local grocery brands including Fife Sourdough and Callister Craft Sodas. It positions itself as a community hub in the tradition of corner stores and milk bars worldwide.
